# Ultrastable seed

> The code-only kernel a new autonomous system starts from: bootstrapper, tick Worker, roles, agent instructions and the loops that run it. Licence: LicenseRef-Ultrastable-USL-1.0 (source-available, non-commercial use free).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [SYSTEM.md](SYSTEM.md): what the system is, generated from its code
- [IDEA.md](IDEA.md): the one file a person writes
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the machine-readable manifest

## Code

- [bootstrap/bootstrap.py](bootstrap/bootstrap.py): boot stages from idea to running system
- [worker/src/tick.js](worker/src/tick.js): the heartbeat
- [autonomy/repo-conformance.json](autonomy/repo-conformance.json): the files every repository carries
